summary: This file exports a custom configuration object for MDX (a format that lets you mix Markdown with React components). It takes all the default MDX components, adds a custom Snippets component to the mix, and exports the combined set so other parts of the app can use both the standard and custom components.

explanations.6: The three dots (...) is the spread operator — it copies all properties from MDXComponents into this new object, so we inherit all the default functionality.
explanations.7: This adds the Snippets component as a new property to the exported object, making it available as a usable component in MDX files alongside all the defaults.
